risk_note: RV2 (packages/db). pg-url credential redaction rewritten as one scanning state machine: quoted and unquoted secret values, escapes skipped, a secret assignment after a closing quote plus any whitespace / & keeps masking, every secret assignment rescans from its own value start (the masked span takes the farther end); oauth_client_secret, scram_client_key and scram_server_key are secrets; more libpq keywords keep ordinary fields readable. Only over-masking changes (one unit expectation: an unclosed quote after an embedded secret key masks to the end). Callers are packages/db/scripts error output only.
